messages:
Sophia: Quick design check — uploaded new mockups for the Test Run detail + Regression Diff timeline (mockup v3). Main asks: keyboard nav, approval microcopy, bulk-approve flow. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (mockup v3). Thoughts?

Kevin: Looking now. Main concern: focus order when the diff panel collapses. If compact diffs push details off-screen we need a persistent floating approve bar. Also: use `aria-live=\"polite\"` on the score update region so SR users hear regression changes. Microcopy nits: suggest changing 'Approve' -> 'Mark as Accepted' or maybe 'Accept Changes' (verb consistency).

Anya: Implementation note — floating bar is doable but conflicts with full-screen diff zoom. We'll need a focus trap when the approve modal opens. Also, continuous keyboard events can cause missed toggles in the large table (spacebar gets swallowed).

Mike: From QA: the tooltip for regression score currently says 'delta 0.02' which confuses PMs. Recommend 'Quality delta: +2' and a hover explainer like 'Change vs baseline (higher is better)'. For bulk-approve: add a pre-check that lists tests with failing assertions and warn the reviewer.

a11y-bot: Automated a11y scan on mockup v3 results: 3 contrast issues (low contrast in row meta), missing `aria-label` on inline approve button, keyboard focus not visible on diff rows. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/2087654321/a11y.json

Jules: +1 to confirmation step for bulk approve. Keyboard shortcuts proposal: `Space` toggles selection, `A` opens approve modal for focused item, `Shift+A` executes bulk approve (with confirm). Prototype focus ring CSS to start: 
```css
.diff-row:focus { outline: 3px solid #00A3FF; }
```
Note: outline on long lists may be slow on some GPUs; consider `box-shadow`.

Sophia: Copy decision: use 'Accept Changes' for primary action, 'Request Changes' for secondary. Kevin — can you update mockups with that phrasing and add the floating bar variant? Action items: Kevin -> update figma by EOD; Jules/Anya -> feasibility + keyboard shortcuts by tomorrow; Mike -> define failing-assertion rules for the warning modal; I'll consolidate copy and send to Legal if needed for audit trail text.

Kevin: Tiny nit — visually disabled rows should have `aria-disabled=\"true\"` and a tooltip 'no longer relevant'. That also helps screen reader users skip them.

Anya: Implementation PR note: prefer `box-shadow` for the focus indicator to avoid repaints: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,163,255,0.18);` Also will add `aria-pressed` to inline toggles.

Mike: QA will add regression tests for: keyboard nav (tab + space), focus ring visible, and bulk-approve confirmation flow. Will include a test case for the tooltip copy change.

Jules: I'll add an 'Export selected results' link in the approve modal so reviewers can download a CSV of selected diffs before accepting. Small UX: add a count badge to bulk button like 'Approve (12)'.

Sophia: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. Scheduling a 15-min sync tomorrow 10:30am PST to run through keyboard flows. If you can't make it, ping me and drop comments on the figma.

Kevin: OK, will add a11y callouts and the floating bar mock.

Anya: I'll scope the keyboard shortcuts and put a short implementation plan in the PR description.

Mike: I'll start writing the QA checklist and add the failing-assertion edge cases.

a11y-bot: Reminder: re-run a11y scan after mock updates — tag `@a11y-bot` in PR to auto-scan.
